exec bash -lc 'p="${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.claude}/projects"; r=$(cd -P -- "$p" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P) || exit 3; d=$(cd -P -- "$p/$1" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P) || exit 3; case "$d" in "$r"/*) ;; *) exit 3 ;; esac; f=$(ls -t -- "$d" | while IFS= read -r n; do case "$n" in (*.jsonl) [ -f "$d/$n" ] && [ ! -L "$d/$n" ] && { printf "%s\n" "$d/$n"; break; } ;; esac; done); [ -n "$f" ] && exec cat -- "$f"; exit 3' skill-probe -home-claude-bot-factory-work-jobs-job-1-repo
